# Voxarel
# https://www.voxarel.com/llms.txt
# Specification: https://llmstxt.org

> Voxarel is logistics operations software for cargo and courier companies. It gives a
> forwarder one system to run bookings and shipping quotes, warehouse stock, finance
> (invoicing, VAT, COD settlement), inventory across branches, mobile field operations, and
> Pulse, a built-in AI assistant that answers questions about shipments, stock and approvals
> in plain language. Voxarel is built for the Gulf-to-India corridor: cargo and courier
> businesses moving freight between the GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain)
> and India. It is operated by Azraq Ventures LLC, based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, and is
> used in production by an international courier network running 12+ branches and 200+ field
> agents between the Gulf and India.

## What Voxarel is for

Voxarel replaces the patchwork of WhatsApp groups, spreadsheets and disconnected apps that
cargo and courier companies use to run day-to-day operations. Everything, whether a booking, a
warehouse scan, an invoice, or a driver's cash settlement, lives in one system, so every role
sees the same up-to-date picture.

## Who uses Voxarel

Cargo companies, courier companies, cargo consolidators and freight forwarders operating on the
Gulf-to-India corridor. Inside those businesses, Voxarel serves the CEO or owner, operations and
branch managers, warehouse managers, finance managers, field agents and drivers. Each gets a
view tailored to their job.

## Platform modules

1. Shipping: quotes, bookings, corridor rates, invoices and proof of delivery. Every shipment
   tracked from first call to final signature.
2. Warehouse: barcode scan in and out, bin locations, expiry flags and variance checks.
3. Finance: invoice to payment to reconciliation. Month-end closes in hours; records are
   audit-ready on demand.
4. Inventory: live stock levels across every branch, showing what is in, what is moving, and
   what needs attention.
5. Field operations: collections, routes and cash settlement from a phone, for agents and
   drivers.
6. Pulse AI: a built-in assistant. Ask about shipments, stock or approvals in plain language;
   answers come from live operational data.
